Job Description

For managing and replying to messages for an English-language Instagram page, we need a detail-oriented, responsible Instagram admin with strong English skills.

Responsibilities:
• Fast and professional replies to page DMs
• Correct understanding of English text messages and voice messages
• Replying in English with a natural, correct tone suitable for the audience
• Following up and managing conversations until resolution
• Identifying questions/requests that need escalation
• Following the page guidelines and defined tone

Requirements:
• Good command of English, especially for everyday conversations and writing
• Ability to understand English voice messages with different accents
• Ability to write natural, error-free replies in English
• High responsiveness and speed in replying
• Good familiarity with Instagram and DM management
• Ability to use VPN consistently and reliably
• Responsibility, accuracy, and strong follow-up
• Reliable internet access and availability during agreed working hours

Nice to have:
• Experience as an admin for English-language pages
• Customer Support or Community Management experience
• Interest in music

Important note:
This role is not simple admin work or content posting. The main part of the job is direct communication with English-speaking audiences and fast, accurate replies to text and voice messages.

Please mention your English level, relevant experience, and (if possible) a sample of your admin or Customer Support experience in your resume or application.
